title: Protect local task edits when importing after discarded rebuild output from an older store
outcome: A source-backed legacy rebuild without an owned publication journal cannot let automatic import of the original clean parent revert local work.
acceptance: A deterministic fixture covers a previously imported legacy folder head, rebuild output discarded back to the original committed files, and both live and dry-run ordinary import. Neither restores older planning or silently advances the comparison basis.
Explicit basis and rebuild commands retain their existing semantics and direct operators to a working remedy.
